source.title: Rigidity and non local connectivity of Julia sets of some quadratic polynomials
source.author: Genadi Levin

closed_branches.condition: There is a renormalization subsequence with limsup log(abs(p_m))/n_m > 0.
closed_branches.satellite_specialization: For satellite renormalizations, limsup log(q_m)/n_m > 0 suffices.
closed_branches.conclusion: Mandelbrot local connectivity at the parameter.

closed_branches.condition: All renormalizations are satellite, q_m tends to infinity, and limsup abs(t_{m+1})^(1/q_m) < 1.
closed_branches.explicit_sufficient_subcase: abs(t_{m+1})^(1/q_m) <= 1/2 eventually, which implies q_{m+1} >= 2 q_m eventually.
closed_branches.conclusion: Mandelbrot local connectivity at the limiting parameter; the Julia set may be non-locally connected.

remaining_scope: unbounded satellite sequences failing both Levin growth tests
ledger_policy: Keep global MLC and virtual obligations open; this certificate closes only the named Levin branches.
